name: codex-unobserved-unparsed
description: A Codex patch p1 is observed (unique context, placed with certainty). A second patch `u` could not be parsed (observed: unparsed). Codex reports no old file, so no later op can reveal what `u` wrote: the engine can never learn the real text of the changed line, hence stage `align`. Rule 6 with its own reason: the one line `u` changed is Unknown(unparsed). p1's line and the untouched line keep their origin.
